EQCT.description: Seismic Load Combination Member Type (EQCT). The assigned member type drives the single field, selecting the seismic load case applied to the member.

TYPE.description: Assign Member Type. Seismic load type applied to the member (case-insensitive on input). Serialized wire values: 'Special Seismic Loads', 'Vertical Seismic Forces'.
